descriptionChirho: Proper noun חֶרְמוֹן (Hermon), the prominent mountain at the northern boundary of Israel, rising to ~2,814 m in the Anti-Lebanon range. Referenced in Deut 3:8–9; 4:48; Josh 11:3, 17; 12:1, 5; 13:5, 11; Ps 42:7; 89:13; 133:3; Song 4:8; 1 Chr 5:23. The two clusters differ only in prepositional and conjunctive framing (bare name / l-Hermon vs. w-Hermon). Multilingual evidence uniformly identifies the same mountain: eng 'Hermon/Chermon', spa 'Hermón/Jermón', hin हेर्मोन, arb حَرْمون/حِرْمُون, kor 헤르몬, swa 'Hermoni.'
